parameters.name: attachResourceType
parameters.description:
The types of attachment points supported by the policy. Valid values: 

- HttpApi
- Operation
- GatewayRoute
- GatewayService
- GatewayServicePort
- Domain
- Gateway

parameters.name: withAttachments
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return attachment information.

parameters.name: withSystemPolicy
parameters.description: Specifies whether it is a system policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun apig list-policies --with-attachments false --attach-resource-id api-cq7l5s5lhtgi6qasrdc0 --attach-resource-type HttpApi --environment-id env-cq7l5s5lhtgi6qasrdc0 --gateway-id gw-cq2fm65lhtgm9nrrl7ag --with-system-policy true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun apig GET /v1/policies --region cn-hangzhou --attachResourceId 'api-cq7l5s5lhtgi6qasrdc0' --attachResourceType HttpApi --environmentId 'env-cq7l5s5lhtgi6qasrdc0' --withAttachments false --gatewayId 'gw-cq2fm65lhtgm9nrrl7ag' --withSystemPolicy true --header "Content-Type=application/json"
